GNB.note: Page states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: The OKINKA landing page presents a live national AI assistant answering questions from citizens, diaspora, investors and tourists, and describes it as property of the Guinean state, a claim made by the site itself.

GNB.note: OKINKA is a general assistant, not a tool inside a sector's public system.

facts.fact: The OKINKA site presents a national AI assistant in service in Portuguese, Kriol, French, Balanta, Fula and Mandinka, claiming state ownership and development with Estonia's Goldenseal Group; the site itself is the only source.

systems.owner: Guinea-Bissau state (site's own claim), built with Goldenseal Group (Estonia)

GNB.note: Page says nothing on the central bank or payments.
Training offered is for the public and firms, not civil servants.
Page says nothing on financial consumer protection.
Page says nothing on cross-border payments.

facts.fact: The OKINKA site offers a free 15-module Digital & AI training course (mobile money, e-commerce, AI tools, app building) to young people and adults, on a platform it says is state-owned; no number trained is given.

GNB.note: Page says nothing on government payments to people.
Page says nothing on shared digital infrastructure.
Page only names mobile money as a training topic, with no service stated.
Page says nothing on tax or fee payment.
